digest.component_or_area: plan-review criteria routing and G7 blocking enablement
propositions: G7 routing entry must change from default_posture 'advisory' at block_threshold 0.95 to default_posture 'blocking' at block_threshold 0.85 to enable plan-review blocking with zero false positives across 348 historical findings at priority >= 0.85

G7 floor-grade blocking at 0.85 should admit both contradicts_reality and omits_required_site kinds (which hard-floor impact at 0.85) but exclude incomplete_enumeration (which contributes 0.55 impact and cannot reach the blocking threshold)

G7 rubric must be enhanced with four guidance rules: fail-open abstain-with-coverage for unresolvable parents, closed-parent final-state contract checking with sibling-handoff scope exclusion, dedup-at-source one-finding-per-contradicted-parent-clause, and floor-kind guidance to prevent cosmetic mismatches from auto-blocking

Pinned blocking-set assertions in test_threshold_recalibration.py, test_impact_model_versioning.py, and test_plan_review_g7.py must be updated to reflect G7 at (0.85, 'blocking'), and a new G7_BLOCKING constant must be added to the set-union expression for blocking criteria

Real pass-3 plan-review wrapper with real impact_plan must produce findings that block when graded contradicts_reality or omits_required_site at validity >= 0.85, floor to priority 0.85, and stay advisory at incomplete_enumeration priority 0.55
Generated criteria guide must be regenerated via the registry regenerate-criteria-guide command to reflect the updated G7 routing and rubric changes
